# Support

Thanks for using Composio! If you need help, use the following channels:

- Documentation: https://docs.composio.dev
- Discord: https://discord.gg/composio (best for community help and quick questions)
- Dashboard: open a ticket from the Support page at https://dashboard.composio.dev/~/org/support (account issues, private questions, or anything that needs the team to look at your account)

Please avoid filing account-specific support requests as GitHub issues unless you believe you’ve found a bug in the SDKs, CLI, docs, or a hosted toolkit. Account-specific support requests filed here are closed with a pointer to the dashboard Support page. For security issues, do not open a public issue—follow `.github/SECURITY.md`.

## Before asking for help
- Check open and closed issues
- Search the docs and Discord
- Include versions, logs, minimal repro steps, and expected vs. actual behavior

We do our best to respond within 2–3 business days.
